sen2018.label: Senate 2018
sen2018.source: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2018 (doi:10.7910/DVN/NVQYMG), summed to counties (medsl-2018-county-senate-governor-house.csv). Statewide Republican and Democratic sums match the FEC 2018 compilation within 0.05 percent in 27 of 33 states; Indiana and New Jersey run about 1.5 percent short; Connecticut and New York count candidates across fusion lines.
notes: CA: no Democrat-vs-Republican race; no data
MN: special election on the same ballot left out
MS: special election on the same ballot left out
VT: no Democrat-vs-Republican race; no data
IN: left out Cass, Gibson, Harrison, Vanderburgh, Vigo (more votes than the President 2016 race)
NY: 12 of 59 counties report more votes than the President 2016 race; the state is left out
ND: left out Rolette (more votes than the President 2016 race)

gov2022.label: Governor 2022
notes: The 34 states whose 2026 governor's seat was last filled in 2022; New Hampshire and Vermont (two-year terms) are not in this file for 2022.
MI: left out Mackinac (more votes than the President 2020 race)
NY: left out Chenango, Otsego, Putnam (more votes than the President 2020 race)
Connecticut reports by planning region, which these county shapes predate; left out.
gov2022.source: Prior-race columns of the county governor file: MIT Election Data and Science Lab 2022 precinct files summed to counties, Tennessee from OpenElections (see senate-and-governor-2026-vs-prior-race-by-county-2026-11-04.md); checked against MEDSL statewide totals only.

govprior.label: the previous governor's race
govprior.source: Previous governor's race by county (2022, or 2024 in New Hampshire and Vermont): see senate-and-governor-2026-vs-prior-race-by-county-2026-11-04.md.
notes: Connecticut reports by planning region, which these county shapes predate; left out.

notes.AK: Alaska reports presidential results by state House district, not by borough, so it has no county data here.
notes.CT: Connecticut is drawn on its eight historic counties, the codes the certified presidential file uses.
notes.KC: Kansas City, Missouri reports separately; its votes are added to Jackson County, though the city also reaches into Clay, Platte and Cass counties.
notes.VA: Falls Church city is added to Fairfax County and Bedford city (2016) to Bedford County.
